description: Run a saved test scenario against one of the business's agents and grade the agent's replies: pass eval_id for one scenario, or agent_id for every scenario saved for that agent (see list_evals). The test is a simulated text conversation with the agent's current live configuration; no phone call is placed, no customer is contacted and the agent's configuration is not changed. Each run uses paid voice-agent provider capacity and is recorded with its result. Returns pass or fail per scenario with the grader's reasons.

agent_id.description: Run every saved scenario for this agent. Either this or eval_id is required.

eval_id.description: Run this one saved scenario (from list_evals). Either this or agent_id is required.

max_wait_ms.description: Per-run wait cap in ms when wait is true (default 60000, max 110000).

wait.description: Wait for the grade before returning (default true).

name: run_eval
title: Run Agent Eval
